doc: Non-finite rotation periods (+inf, -inf, NaN) on an Earth-sized body: hadley_edge_raw is infinity for all of them (the test is `p is None or not isfinite(p) or p == 0`), so there is no storm track and the scale is exactly 0. Exact. Arguments: ONE body per element of the input array `rotation` (rotation_period_days; JSON params cannot hold infinities and NaN, so they are an input), the three other fields of the body shared in params (radius_km, gravity_mps2, scale_height_km, cloud_regime). Output: scale, one float64 per rotation (this case has no params.bodies).
